decisions.reason: Reusing the existing Sign In background for the Provisioning Wizard does not change the Sign In page's own styling.
The Provisioning Wizard background reuse does not alter the Sign In rough-code deliverable or its Cognito customization boundary.
The styling decision is already owned by the Provisioning Wizard styling Requirement and does not change the existence or type of the separately requested rough-code deliverable.
The source changes the Provisioning Wizard background and does not confirm any change to footer content, layout, color, or page applicability.
The legal-document PDF behavior is established by a separate clause and is unaffected by the Provisioning Wizard background reuse.
The source concerns styling of the actual Provisioning Wizard, not the landing-page description of the provisioning process.
Reusing a background derived from the landing page does not modify the landing page's visual system.
The panel-layout discussion is a separate clause and the Provisioning Wizard background decision does not resolve or change the navigation-panel arrangement.
The Provisioning Wizard is an embedded page outside the shared console-shell styling boundary, so its background reuse does not alter the shell design.
The source makes no change to landing-page breakpoints or responsive layout behavior.
Background reuse does not change the reusable responsive-design guidance for website pages.
The source applies an existing background to one Provisioning Wizard page and does not revise the shared theme or chrome rules for follow-on webpages.
